# Afnan Javed

> Official personal portfolio of Afnan Javed, an independent software founder and systems builder based in Pakistan.

Website: https://afnanjaved.com/
Contact: afnanjaved38@gmail.com
GitHub: https://github.com/afnanjaved38-stack

## Who is Afnan Javed?

Afnan Javed builds and operates software platforms and collaborates with businesses and organizations on practical digital systems. His interests include custom business software, business process automation, and useful AI integration.

Afnan founded Dinaaro and EduPulse and continues to develop these platforms. He uses modern development tools and AI agents as part of his independent workflow. AI is a development aid, not a substitute for understanding requirements, testing operational workflows, making product decisions, or maintaining accountability for delivered work.

## Owned software platforms

### Dinaaro
Official product website: https://dinaaro.com/
Founder: Afnan Javed
Category: Retail management

Dinaaro helps retail businesses manage sales, inventory, customer credit, supplier accounts, and daily operations within a connected platform. It is designed with retail workflows in Pakistan and Saudi Arabia in mind.

Reported milestones provided by the founder as of October 2026:
- More than PKR 1 million in transaction value
- 2 retail shops
- More than 1 year of operating history
- Operations spanning Pakistan and Saudi Arabia

### EduPulse
Official product website: https://edupulse.com/
Founder: Afnan Javed
Category: School management

EduPulse supports student records, attendance, fees, assignments, school communication, and personalized AI learning assistance.

Reported milestones provided by the founder as of October 2026:
- More than 900 students managed
- 2 schools
- Presence in 2 of 4 regions used in the founder's reporting framework for Pakistan

## Selected client work

Switch Power Co. is a Saudi Arabia business website project aimed at creating a clearer online business presence and presenting product information to customers. Its website is https://switchpowersa.com/.

Nexus Tech is a Pakistan online storefront project for digital products and subscriptions. It includes custom subscription tracking and renewal reminder workflows.

## Services and collaboration

Afnan works with businesses and organizations on:
- Custom software solutions, including management systems and business applications built for specific operational requirements
- Business automation that replaces repetitive tasks and fragmented manual processes with organized digital workflows
- AI integration where it can help with routine work, access to information, and operational tasks

He is currently not accepting individual personal projects.

Business project inquiries can be sent to afnanjaved38@gmail.com or initiated from the contact section of the portfolio.
